In the annual London Business Houses Cross County Championships, Matt Kinane finished 2nd, thus contibuting to London Transport's team win over British Airways.

Other good performances on the day came from Matt Kinane 33rd, Mike Webb 49th, and Mike Lake, who has run strongly all season, 65th. 1, G.Staines (Belgrave) 26:47; 2, K.Tadesse (Belgrave) 27:02; 3, K.Penney (Boxhill R) 27:10; 15, J.Estall 28:17; 32, M.Bizio 29:04; 33, M.Kinane 29:07; 49, M.Webb 29:3…

On the positive side, the team was led home by a very solid run from Matt Kinane in 33rd. It was good to see Rob Turner and Mark Sinclair running, and Matt Hillier and 1500m runner Junior Galley scored for the first time.

Again Matt Kinane led the team home in 20th position after a very good run. Then came Graham Adams, Jim Estall, Roger Alsop, Phil Carstairs and Matt Hillier all fairly close and swapping positions throughout the race.
1 mile · 4:26.0 · Matt Kinane · 7th, Peter Coe Mile, Crystal Palace · 11 Sep 1985
Matt Kinane, living in Sweden and a member of Swansea H, rejoining 2nd-claim many years after he started his athletics career with us as a young boy.

It was back in 1987 that we last lined up a Junior Men’s squad – four to a team in those days, when the race was held at Crystal Palace – and we placed 7th with Matt and Justin Chaston, Matt Kinane and Glen Tiernan.
